subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which stable Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but choosing union_id, another identity field, cross-app open_id collection, or a documented limitation affects message admission and can suppress or misroute Feishu group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework the linked PR on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering parser, post, command, mention-forward, debounce, and live multi-bot behavior.

options.title: Document Feishu Limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Multi-Bot Work
options.body: Use this issue as part of a larger Feishu multi-bot routing design only if maintainers want mention identity, bot-to-bot visibility, and session scope solved together.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework the linked PR on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering parser, post, command, mention-forward, debounce, and live multi-bot behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the linked PR, requested changes on the exact identity decision surface, and have recent Feishu mention-handling history.
